chapter_units.strongest_correctness_objection: Cross-experiment fitted trends or cellwise-threshold correlations need not be biological scaling laws or predictions without extra fitting; both limits are stated.
chapter_units.source_locator: Mainali2025 Fig4A-B; supplement S3/S4; parameter-crop image inspected

chapter_units.essential_reasoning_chain: Expectation is explicitly over independent zero-mean weights, so fixed input profiles need not have zero spatial means. The finite-dimensional central-limit condition includes normalization and no dominating term. Cross terms vanish in the covariance because weights are independent and centered.
chapter_units.strongest_correctness_objection: Many inputs do not automatically yield a Gaussian limit; centered independent weights, normalization and no single dominating contributor are explicit.
chapter_units.source_locator: Supplement S2 EqsS2-S4 and conditions afterS8; direct expectation algebra

chapter_units.essential_reasoning_chain: Dense uniform translated profiles give the covariance integral away from boundaries; independent weights do not themselves imply stationarity. Gaussian autocorrelation gives exp(-Delta²/(4b²)) and standard-deviation width sqrt2b. This width convention is explicitly stated. The final circuit conclusion remains a possible sufficient account and admits structured or learned alternatives.
chapter_units.strongest_correctness_objection: Random weights do not establish stationarity, smoothness or unique wiring; coverage/tuning conditions and alternative circuit mechanisms remain explicit.
chapter_units.source_locator: Supplement S5-S8; direct completing square; Mainali2025 Discussion

chapter_units.essential_reasoning_chain: The comparison distinguishes a spatial tuning function, a stored state coordinate and actual downstream eye motion. It keeps the 2022 upstream-source evidence and model sufficiency separate from an information-bound measurement and from the static2025 map. The table matches those objects.
chapter_units.strongest_correctness_objection: The three position variables are different; the comparison names each object and does not treat static maps as a memory update law.
chapter_units.source_locator: 2012 Eqs1-5;2022 Figs2-5;2025 Eq1; tbl:SYNTHESIS-MODELS

chapter_units.essential_reasoning_chain: Composing fixed f_i with a moving x(t) is explicitly a guide construction. Taylor linearization and conditional variance2Dt give the covariance of expected-rate changes. Private spike noise, common fluctuations, finite movement and threshold corners are explicitly outside that formula.
chapter_units.strongest_correctness_objection: The shared-displacement covariance is conditional and local, for expected rates; Taylor and noise limitations are explicit.
chapter_units.source_locator: Direct Taylor expansion and covariance identity; foundations tuning/covariance/diffusion teaching

chapter_units.essential_reasoning_chain: With slopes2 and-1, displacement variance.01 gives rate variances.04,.01 and covariance-.02Hz². The one-source correlation is exactly-1 in the local linear example; independent private variance lowers its magnitude. The figure shows the correct+.1m displacement and paired changes, with no inhibitory-link inference.
chapter_units.strongest_correctness_objection: Negative covariance need not mean inhibition or remain perfect with private noise; the example makes the common-position cause explicit.
chapter_units.source_locator: Direct arithmetic and correlation formula; fig:SYNTHESIS-SHARED-POSITION inspected

chapter_units.essential_reasoning_chain: The evidence comparison keeps fitted gain, finite-threshold model/data checks, calibration assumptions and the mathematical versus empirical status visible. Shared covariance is conditional on the decomposition assumptions, while stationary motor-noise amplitude alone cannot generate the modeled accumulating upstream component. A scaling exponent alone does not test the bound constant.
chapter_units.strongest_correctness_objection: Compatible-looking scaling does not test the full bound and common-drive evidence does not uniquely locate its source; the test-matching bullets preserve those limits.
chapter_units.source_locator: Mainali2025 STAR Methods; Ben-Shushan2022 Figs2-5/Methods; BurakFiete2012 Eqs1-5

chapter_units.essential_reasoning_chain: The related-work paragraphs report broad original results and draw limited consequences: line-attractor and goldfish perturbation background; coded storage and short-term plasticity extensions; reused place recordings and laterCA3/CA1 contrast; measured structure/plasticity; and intermediate movement benefits. They do not claim these sources uniquely locate a generator or refute another model outside shared assumptions.
chapter_units.strongest_correctness_objection: Related study summaries might be transferred across animals, scales or model choices; each contribution is limited and Stage1 checked original-source support.
chapter_units.source_locator: See related_work_checks list with original-source locators

chapter_units.essential_reasoning_chain: The proposed experiment requires maps and fluctuations from the same population, appropriate local diffusion range and observation filters. Neither map statistics nor diffusion alone is claimed to identify the other. The final paragraph explicitly labels this follow-up work.
chapter_units.strongest_correctness_objection: A map or diffusion fit alone does not establish their joint coupling; the proposed steps require same-population maps/fluctuations and relevant filters.
chapter_units.source_locator: Direct inference from model assumptions and preceding covariance example
